promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Geometry/layout authority: reskin exactly, never move
Image 2: Material/style only; not layout
Image 3: Material/style only; not layout
Image 4: Identity only: a light MG with a side drum; not layout

Asset type: production-source master for a top-down game sprite: a LIGHT MACHINE GUN ON A ROOF PINTLE, the gun a gunner works from the roof hatch of an olive-drab army utility vehicle. It sits on a separate round turntable plate drawn underneath it later; draw only the gun and its cradle.

Image 1 is the exact geometry and layout authority: reskin it, never move, resize, widen or add to its shapes. Keep every part on its place: the slim barrel with a short flash hider at the top, the perforated cooling jacket down the centre line, the narrow rectangular receiver with its hinged top cover, the cocking handle stub on the left, the pintle cradle yoke across the receiver with its two round trunnion caps, the large round ammunition drum seated on the RIGHT side of the receiver joined by a short feed throat, the back plate and the twin spade grips with the trigger between them at the bottom. The barrel, jacket, receiver, cradle and grips stay exactly on the vertical centre line of the canvas; only the drum sits to the right. Keep all empty canvas empty.

Image 2 and Image 3 are material and style reference only, never layout: dull olive-drab painted steel with lighter worn edges and dark gunmetal working parts, fine surface noise, panel seams, small bolts, paint chips and grime, crisp painted game-sprite finish, lighting from the upper left. Image 4 is identity reference only: a light support machine gun with a round side drum magazine; never copy its layout, mounting tab or proportions.

Primary request: a compact, believable light machine gun that reads clearly against the olive-drab plate in Image 2, which it will sit on: the whole gun is DARK - blackened gunmetal barrel and flash hider, a near-black steel cooling jacket with a row of round vent holes, a dark parkerized grey-black receiver and cradle with lighter worn steel on its edges and bolt heads, black grips; only the drum is painted, in a slightly lighter, warmer olive-drab than Image 2 with a dark steel rim, so it reads as a round pan magazine with a centre hub and a ribbed face. Crisp dark outline round the whole silhouette. Same wear and detail level as the vehicle in Image 3.

Strict 90-degree zenith orthographic top-down view. The camera looks straight down on the gun's top surfaces; the gun fires toward the TOP edge of the canvas, level with the ground, so no circular bore or muzzle face is visible, only a thin dark slit at the very tip. True transparent background, including between the spade grips; no ground, plate, turntable, vehicle, shadow slab, cast shadow, halo, border, text or labels.

Avoid: a second gun, belts of ammunition, a gun shield, a person or hands, a turret, perspective, side view, isometric view, white or cyan paint, glowing lights, text.
